parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, documented police/border targeting, facility ban, or trans-specific violence is documented; consensual same-sex conduct was decriminalised in 2016 and immigration-detention rules bar gender-identity discrimination in that estate. Offsetting this, there is no documented social acceptance of trans visitors or working visitor-facing recourse: prison placement, enforcement of the detention rule, border-document and facility practice are undocumented open questions. Absence of legal recognition, marriage, and employment protection is resident-facing and only a light climate signal, as is the low composite index; it does not create a traveller exposure. In this thin-data dossier, silence is not safety, so the rating sits a step below documented acceptance-with-protections, but with no heavy tier-1 to tier-3 exposure documented.
